answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 33277 Country: Pakistan Title: If we have a gold set (jewellery) for e.g. 80 grams which has 70 grams gold and 10 grams wastage. Question: If we have a gold set (jewellery) for e.g. 80 grams which has 70 grams gold and 10 grams wastage. Will the weight be counted 80 grams or 70 grams? Answer ID: 33277 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1422/868/H=1432) It shall be counted as 80 grams. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
